title: crafted cost=i32::MAX passes load validation; i32 dist sums wrap in routing_rebuild
detail: jint_strict admits cost = i32::MAX (in range, >= 1). Two such hops wrap nd negative; the min-scan extracts it first, and a wrapped -1 equals UNREACHABLE, silently erasing routes. A crafted pipe_tiers.json corrupts the routing table.
recommended_fix: Cap cost at load (e.g. cost <= 1e6, per deferred-work.md) or accumulate dist in i64 in routing_rebuild so sums cannot wrap; keep the >= 1 lower bound.
